hypothesis: Special-case the fixed workload's all-valid text masks to None so cross-attention can use a fused H100 SDPA backend without materializing or applying a zero additive bias.

exact_workload_tokenizer_audit.semantic_note: For both fixed branches the current additive attention bias is identically zero, so replacing it with None is mathematically exact and preserves every token and attention invocation.

backend_evidence.no_mask_backend: the same cuDNN SM90 WGMMA flash kernel
backend_evidence.interpretation: The premise that a non-null zero mask prevents fused SDPA is false in this Torch/cuDNN build. Auto already selects the fused SM90 kernel, and the remaining projected gain is far below run noise.

decision.reason: The bounded source/shape/GPU gate disproved a material backend switch. A predicted 0.058-second denoising saving is not a genuinely high-impact hypothesis and cannot distinguish itself from the established sub-second run variance.
